product.title: A portal that feels like part of the stay
product.lead: Guests scan a QR code or open a link — and land in a branded experience built around your property. Everything they need before, during, and after check-in.
product.li1: Property essentials: Wi‑Fi, check-in info, house rules, and appliance guides
product.li2: AI assistant trained on your house guide — answers in the guest's language
product.li3: Curated local services, hidden gems, and bookable excursions
product.li4: One-tap WhatsApp, maps, and review prompts when it matters
product.label1P: No more PDFs lost in email threads. Your content lives in a beautiful, always-updated portal.
product.label2P: Guests ask about parking, the washing machine, or checkout — and get instant, accurate answers.
product.label3P: Promote trusted partners, experiences, and services — with direct guest contact or booking flows.
product.label4P: Guests save Vailo like an app. No App Store. No friction.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: Do guests need to download an app?
faq.a1: No. Vailo runs in the browser. Guests can add it to their home screen for one-tap access — it feels like an app without the App Store.
faq.q2: How does the AI know about my property?
faq.a2: The assistant is grounded in your house guide — rules, appliances, check-in details, and host notes you configure. It answers from your content, not generic travel advice.
faq.a3: Yes. Vailo is built for portfolios. Each listing gets its own portal, QR code, and house guide — managed from a single admin dashboard.
faq.q4: Is it available in multiple languages?
faq.a4: The guest portal and AI assistant support multiple languages. You can provide content in the locales your guests speak most.
faq.a5: Request a presentation and we'll walk you through setup. Existing partners can log in directly to the platform admin to configure properties and publish guest portals.

cta.title: Ready to elevate every stay?
cta.p: Join property owners and managers who treat guest experience as a product — not an afterthought.
